description: Safe construction of dynamic SOQL — Database.query bind variables (:varName), Database.queryWithBinds(query, Map<String,Object>, AccessLevel) (API 57.0+), field-name allowlisting, ORDER BY direction whitelist, LIMIT/OFFSET typing, and WITH USER_MODE interaction (WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED can't be used at API 67.0 and later). NOT for reviewing a query for injection or CRUD/FLS generally — use apex/soql-security. NOT for Schema.describe and runtime type inspection — use apex/dynamic-apex.
inputs: User-supplied filter values, field names, sort columns, or limits
The dynamic SOQL string being built
Required AccessLevel (USER_MODE vs SYSTEM_MODE) and FLS posture
Schema of the queried sObject (for field-name allowlisting)
name: apex-dynamic-soql-binding-safety
official_sources: Apex Developer Guide — Dynamic SOQL — supports `queryWithBinds` (API 57.0), the `accessLevel` parameter (API 55.0), bind scope and duplicate-key rules: apex dev guide 264 L11595-11672 — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_dynamic_soql.htm

Apex Reference Guide — Database Class (`queryWithBinds`) — signature `queryWithBinds(String, Map<String, Object>, AccessLevel)`: apexref 262 L209135 — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexref.meta/apexref/apex_methods_system_database.htm

Apex Developer Guide — SOQL Injection — `escapeSingleQuotes` and the injection definition: apex dev guide 264 L11675-11681; user-mode clauses and `WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED` at 67.0: L12149-12158, L11926-11927 — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/pages_security_tips_soql.htm

outputs: Database.queryWithBinds call site with explicit bind map
Field-name and ORDER BY direction allowlists
SOQL-injection negative tests asserting safe behavior on attack payloads
Documented USER_MODE / SYSTEM_MODE choice with justification
